summary: AAP 2.6 production topologies are growth (getting started, no redundancy) or enterprise (redundancy, high compute). Missing 2.4 authentication settings after upgrade are explained by migration warnings in setup_log. A SAML authenticator migration fails if it uses an encrypted private key, which 2.4 allowed but 2.6 does not.
questions: Why were my automation controller 2.4 authentication settings not imported?
Why did the SAML authenticator migration fail during the 2.6 upgrade?
Where do I find authenticator migration warnings?
